title: Feature suggestion for My Day
body:
Hello Microsoft To Do team,

I really enjoy using Microsoft To Do — it has become an essential part of my daily workflow. Thank you for building such a clean and helpful productivity app.

I wanted to share a small feature suggestion regarding the My Day section.

It would be extremely useful to have a single button or option that allows users to quickly add the entire list (or series of tasks) from the previous day into today’s My Day.

Right now, when tasks repeat from one day to another, they must be added manually one by one, which can be time-consuming — especially for users with structured daily routines.

Something like “Add yesterday’s My Day tasks” would significantly improve efficiency and user experience.

Thank you for your great work, and I hope this idea can be considered for future updates.

Best regards, 
Rulzok

title: Algunas mejoras sustanciales (Solo Comentarios)
body:

Sin embargo, con esta actualización no se cuenta con algo muy básico, que es la posibilidad de hacer comentarios dentro de cada tarea.

Al tenerla compartida, lo ideal sería poder comentar sobre dicha tarea entre las personas con quien se comparte.

Es una función con la que ya cuenta Wunderlist.

De tener este cambio, cambiaría toda mi operación con poco menos de 500 personas de Wunderlist a Microsoft To-Do.

De nuevo les reitero que el trabajo que hicieron con esta app es de agradecer, lo limpia y clara que es, solo faltan funciones que le den más valor al excelente trabajo que han realizado hasta ahora.

title: Best ToDo App Ever
body:
I am a huge fan of Wunderlist, so when they moved to MS ToDo I was skeptical. And now that they implemented “important” flags, they have everything I need to make it the perfect ToDo App.
You can move items between lists (e.g. critical list to a low priority list), you can select a new date for it easily. You have the desktop app to synchronize.
Finally the “My Day” smart list is new for me... and I like it: items there reset every day, but you still get to review what was missed from day before, the done items and proposed the new ones for the day based on due dates.
Once again: the best ToDo app ever.
